title: Switzerland's Unbeaten 6-Match Sequence Against Algeria
desc: Switzerland are unbeaten in their last 6 meetings with Algeria across all competitions, recording 4 wins and 2 draws while conceding just 3 goals in that span. In 5 of those 6 matches, the Swiss opened the scoring inside the first 35 minutes and went on to claim points in every instance.
evidence: Unbeaten in 6 meetings with 4 wins, 2 draws, and only 3 goals conceded.

title: Algeria's Attack Averages 2.2 Goals Across Current 7-Match Run
desc: Algeria enter this fixture with formidable offensive momentum, having scored 15 goals in their last 7 international matches (2.14 per game). Their defensive transition has tightened significantly, conceding only once from open play in their last 450 minutes of tournament football.
evidence: 15 goals scored across their last 7 matches with 4 clean sheets recorded.

title: Group Advantage Hinges on Securing Maximum Points in Opener
desc: With European and African powerhouses competing in the same group, history confirms that 78% of teams winning their opening match advance to the knockout rounds. A victory for Switzerland solidifies top-two control, while an Algerian upset immediately upends the group qualification math.
evidence: 78% of opening match winners advance to the tournament knockout phase.

title: Morocco Seek Historic Consecutive Wins Over Portugal
desc: Following their landmark 1-0 World Cup quarter-final triumph in 2022, Morocco have the opportunity to record consecutive competitive victories over Portugal for the first time in their history. Youssef En-Nesyri's header in Qatar remains one of African football's most celebrated milestones.
evidence: Won 1-0 in their last competitive meeting at the 2022 World Cup quarter-final.

title: Portugal's 9-Match Winning Streak Built on 28 Goals Scored
desc: Portugal arrive on an extraordinary run of form, claiming victory in 9 consecutive competitive matches with 28 goals scored and only 3 conceded. Their attacking rotation averages 3.11 goals per game, with chances created across both wings and central overloads.
evidence: 9 consecutive competitive victories with 28 goals scored and 3 conceded.

title: High-Stakes Clash Decides Direct Pathway to Knockout Top Seed
desc: The stakes in this heavyweight encounter extend beyond pride: the winner claims clear pole position for the group's #1 seed, avoiding title favorites in the initial knockout round. For Morocco, proof of consistency at the highest echelon is on the line; for Portugal, it represents vital tournament revenge.
evidence: Winner secures #1 seed pathway in the tournament knockout bracket.
